scenes.text: Crows can remember your face for years, and teach other crows to hate you.
Scientists in Seattle wore a scary caveman mask while trapping and tagging wild crows.
Afterwards, whenever someone walked by in that mask, crows dived and scolded them.
Even crows that were never caught joined in, learning from the others.
Young crows picked up the grudge from their parents.
At one site, five years later, three times as many crows were scolding the mask.
Would you dare wear that mask this Halloween?

title: Crows never forget a face (and they tell their friends) 🐦‍⬛
caption: University of Washington researchers wore a caveman mask while trapping crows. For years after, crows scolded anyone in that mask, even crows that were never trapped. 🐦‍⬛
